fix-bug:investigation findings

VERDICT: LIVE (bug confirmed present at HEAD after all recent hardening commits)

## Staleness check
Ticket created: 2026-06-02T22:29Z. Most recent hardening commit: aee139a7f7 (2026-06-02T20:26Z, 'add Pink Elephant failure mode + affirmatively prime two-batch fix pipeline'). That commit updated SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode HARD-GATE #2 to affirm the two-batch dispatch contract — but did NOT add chunk wrap-up logic to dispatch-fix-batch.md. Bug is LIVE.

## Root cause
Instruction Locality failure (#16): dispatch-fix-batch.md Section 7 ends at line 178 with 'move on to chunk wrap-up (sub-branch push, PR open, ticket transitions)' — referencing a wrap-up it never defines. The per-chunk PR + integration steps exist only in SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode Execution step 2 'Per-chunk PR + integration' (lines 418-421), which the orchestrator read in a prior context stage. When executing dispatch-fix-batch.md, the PR mandate is not present in the active document, so the orchestrator pattern-matches to 'collect summaries and continue'.

## Per-element verdict

1. chunk size ≤5 file-disjoint: PRESENT in SKILL.md lines 403-406. NOT co-located in dispatch-fix-batch.md.
2. per-chunk branch off SESSION_HEAD: PARTIAL — branch naming specified (lines 407-408), base ref not explicit in either file.
3. investigation/fix two-batch separation: PRESENT — fully specified in SKILL.md HARD-GATE #2 + dispatch-fix-batch.md Sections 5-7.
4. serial Phase-2 commits: PARTIAL — Phase G 'Serialized integration' (SKILL.md line 816) applies to Diagnostic Mode; not explicitly re-stated for Bug-Fix Mode path.
5. per-chunk gh pr create --base SESSION_BRANCH: MISSING from dispatch-fix-batch.md; PRESENT only in SKILL.md.
6. await CI before merge (MERGED/ESCALATED/ERROR): MISSING from dispatch-fix-batch.md.
7. ticket closure at fix time: PRESENT — delegated to fix-bug Phase I via dispatch-fix-batch.md line 166.
8. end-of-chunk reconciliation: MISSING from both files.

## Exact fix anchors

PRIMARY: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/prompts/dispatch-fix-batch.md line 178
Add Section 9 'Chunk wrap-up (ci-pr mode)' immediately after Section 7/8 with affirmative:
- assert-batch-branch.sh pre-flight
- gh pr create --base SESSION_BRANCH
- await CI; MERGED/ESCALATED/ERROR outcome routing
- end-of-chunk reconciliation (verify K tickets in expected states, write CHUNK_RESULT: comment)
- detect-session-leakage.sh (non-fatal)

SECONDARY: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode step 2 Chunking bullet
Add one line: 'Branch base: create off SESSION_HEAD (git checkout -b <name> while on session branch)'.

## RED test plan
File: tests/skills/test-debug-everything-ci-pr-phase-fg.sh (extend with new sections) OR new test-debug-everything-bug-fix-mode-chunk-wrapup.sh

Test cases (all FAIL RED today):
1. test_dispatch_fix_batch_section_9_exists — grep -qE 'Chunk wrap-up|## 9' dispatch-fix-batch.md
2. test_dispatch_fix_batch_wrapup_gh_pr_create — grep -qE 'gh pr create|open a PR' dispatch-fix-batch.md  (line 178 only says 'PR open' in parenthetical, no instruction)
3. test_dispatch_fix_batch_wrapup_session_branch_base — grep -qE 'SESSION_BRANCH' used in PR creation context in dispatch-fix-batch.md (currently SESSION_BRANCH only injected into sub-agent prompts, not used for PR)
4. test_dispatch_fix_batch_wrapup_await_ci — grep -qiE 'await CI|MERGED.*ESCALATED|wait.*CI' dispatch-fix-batch.md
5. test_skill_md_bug_fix_chunking_base_ref — awk section + grep for SESSION_HEAD or 'git checkout -b' base ref in Bug-Fix Mode section

Pattern: same bash structural-grep style as existing tests. awk section extraction + grep assertions. pass()/fail() helpers.

## Feasibility: HIGH
Purely additive text changes. ~50-80 lines in dispatch-fix-batch.md + ~2 lines in SKILL.md. Canonical patterns (assert-batch-branch.sh, gh pr create --base SESSION_BRANCH, MERGED/ESCALATED/ERROR) already exist in Phase G and need only be promoted to dispatch-fix-batch.md Section 9. No script changes required.
